cwi.jei.incubator.inoculation: Inoculate a sterile Petri dish before the numbered feed steps.
cwi.jei.incubator.uncapping: Uncap the cultured plate with a %s.
cwi.jei.mineral.deposit: Mining this deposit yields %s; process the ore block.
cwi.jei.mineral.yield: %s: %s guaranteed, plus %s%% chance of one extra
cwi.jei.mineral.milled_crushed: Milling one crushed ore yields one powder.
cwi.jei.mineral.milled_lump: Milling one lump yields one powder.
cwi.jei.mineral.concentrate_furnace: Smelt or blast one concentrate into one ingot.
cwi.jei.mineral.crystal_furnace: Smelt or blast one crystal into one ingot.
cwi.jei.mineral.no_furnace: No ordinary smelting or blasting recipe for this concentrate.
cwi.jei.mineral.lignite_fuel: One lignite lump burns for 20 seconds.
cwi.jei.mineral.lignite_powder: This powder currently has no onward processing or fuel use.
cwi.jei.mineral.returned_culture: The culture is returned after processing; it is not created from the mineral.
cwi.jei.mineral.separate_sulfur: These forms come from separate sulfur ores; this sulfur block has no processing recipe.
cwi.jei.mineral.route.brine_culture: 500 mB raw brine with Vulcan Thermus
cwi.jei.mineral.route.coal_culture: Four lignite lumps with Carbofusor Spirillum
cwi.info.ore.powder: Crushing or milling one ore block gives %s powder feed plus a %s%% chance of one extra. Crushed ore must be milled before separation.
cwi.info.ore.average: Average feed: %s powders per ore block.
cwi.info.ore.separation: Main product: %s. Per 100 powders, vibration averages %s concentrates; centrifugation averages %s. Both leave tailings for flotation.
cwi.info.ore.block_yield: Before tailings recovery, this averages %s concentrates per ore block with vibration or %s with centrifugation.
cwi.info.ore.buffer: These are long-run averages, not guaranteed batch outputs. Keep a buffer between chance-based separation and machines that need steady feed.
cwi.info.ore.byproducts: Other possible concentrates: %s. Give each output its own storage or onward route so it cannot fill the machine.
cwi.info.ore.tailings: Flotation recovers more %s: an average of %s concentrates per 100 tailings. It leaves stubborn tailings.
cwi.info.ore.reagent: A steel vat with a mixer uses water and flotation reagent. Check the reagent's production recipe when setting up the supply line.
cwi.info.ore.stubborn_leachable: Regrinding stubborn tailings has a %s%% chance to recover ore powder. This mineral also supports heated acid leaching; wash its solid leach residue while processing the solution separately.
cwi.info.ore.stubborn_physical: This mineral has no acid-leaching route. Regrinding stubborn tailings has a %s%% chance to recover ore powder for another separation pass.
cwi.info.blast_furnace.bootstrap: Start steel refining with air from an air intake. Oxygen is a later efficiency upgrade, not a requirement for the first steel. Supply molten pig iron, liquid silicon and flux through the furnace hatches.
cwi.info.blast_furnace.heat: Heaters supply heat; reinforcement raises the temperature ceiling. Allow the furnace to warm up. A larger chamber increases parallel capacity, but heater power and reinforcement still limit temperature.
cwi.info.blast_furnace.outputs: Drain steel and slag into separate output storage. A full output can stop processing even when the ingredients and heat are ready.
cwi.info.glass.reusable: The batch mixer returns soda and limestone. Filter those outputs back to the mixer while sending the glass batch onward; only the sand needs a continuous new supply for this step.
cwi.info.glass.recovery: Quenching sometimes produces cracked or devitrified glass. Mill the rejects, then compact four glass powders with heat to reclaim one sintered blank. Send it back through pressing and quenching.
cwi.info.slag.casting: Cast slag into blocks in a casting basin to free the furnace's output tank. The blocks can be crushed into solid slag for construction mixtures.
